findings.title: Lithuanian totp step replaced with Italian text
findings.body: loginTotpStep1 was changed to the Italian sentence 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:' in the Lithuanian bundle. Lithuanian users will see Italian text. The same wrong string appears in account/messages_lt.properties line 101. A correct Lithuanian translation, or the English fallback, should be used instead.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese bundle gets Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: totpStep1 was replaced with Traditional Chinese text ('在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：') in the zh_CN file. The surrounding strings use Simplified Chinese, so this is the wrong script for the locale. It should use Simplified characters.

findings.title: Fragile English file derivation, and a missing English file crashes verification
findings.body: The English path is derived with the regex `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties`. It is not anchored and does not handle every locale name. A file with no locale suffix, or with a path that has an earlier underscore, resolves to the wrong path or to the file itself. If the English file does not exist (new theme types, other directories), the code throws a RuntimeException instead of reporting a verification message. The replaceAll on 'resources-community' also rewrites any such substring elsewhere in the path.

findings.title: Anchor check can match wrong occurrence and mismatch counts
findings.body: The anchor matching walks both matchers in lockstep. Extra English anchors absent from the translation are silently allowed. replaceFirst(Pattern.quote(...)) removes the first textual match, which may not be the one just found. Translations that drop an anchor tag, such as a missing closing tag, are not detected.

findings.title: Non-static, non-private mutable fields for policies and patterns
findings.body: POLICY_SOME_HTML, POLICY_NO_HTML and HTML_TAGS are package-private instance fields that are rebuilt for every verifier instance. They should be private static final.
